movelist.name: Thunder Fang
movelist.effect: Thunder Fang Paralyzes or Flinches on 18- 19 during Accuracy Check; flip a coin to determine whether the foe gets Paralyzed or Flinches. On 20 during Accuracy Check, the foe is Paralyzed and Flinched.

movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Reflect
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Reflect may activate it when receiving Physical Damage to resist the Damage one step. Reflect may be activated 2 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Roar
movelist.effect: When declaring Roar, the user does nothing and may not Shift. At the end of the round, the user Shifts and uses Roar.  Targets hit by Roar immediately Shift away from the target using their highest usable movement capability, and towards their Trainer if possible. If the target is an owned Pokémon and ends this shift within 6 meters of their Poké Ball, they are immediately recalled to their Poké Ball. If that Trainer sends out a replacement, they do not lose their Pokémon turn.

abilities.name: Volt Absorb
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Electric-Type attacks, and whenever they are hit with an Electric Type attack, they gain Hit Points equal to a Tick of Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.effect: All foes within 3 meters are Suppressed for 1 full round.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Speed is raised 1 Combat Stage at the end of each of its turns. Speed Boost has no effect while out of combat.
